scope.limitingIntegral: Accepted RGB area over the unit aperture disk divided by accepted aperture area; excludes the finite GPU estimator center term.

accounting.integrandEvaluation: One in-disk evaluatePoint invocation. The M5T budget additionally charges all point-function calls, including out-of-disk cell centers, and each UV-dependent depth probe.
accounting.actualPointEvaluations: In-disk numerical integrand evaluations; reported separately from pointFunctionCalls and depthProbeEvaluations.
accounting.geometricOperations: Disk relation and source-texel boundary predicates; source mapping and probe work are separately counted.
accounting.sourceCache: M5T baseline uses no integrand cache.
accounting.estimatedPeakWorkingMemory: Approximate 128 bytes per retained CellNode plus root/frontier references; estimate only, not a heap profiler measurement.
accounting.overlappingCauses: Boundary category counts overlap; unresolvedAreaByCause fields may also overlap and must not be summed as exclusive areas.

baseline.interpretation: Source-texel boundaries dominate S1/S3; disk boundaries dominate the visible S5 category; S4/S6 are mixed. Categories and unresolved-area causes overlap. No UV-dependent depth probes were needed in these selected inputs.

strategyA.algorithm: Map actual nearest-source texel footprints into aperture coordinates, clip each footprint to the unit disk, integrate circle/polygon area once per source region.
guards: Preserves captured ellipse/cap, observed center identity/UV, top-origin UVs, Float32 nearest-texel mapping, and clamping.
Checks source validity, signed-CoC Far eligibility and depth acceptance per region.
Fails closed when inverse projection permits UV-dependent view distance within a same-texel region.
Budget exhaustion or incomplete/invalid area partition remains unresolved/invalid.

predeclaredDiagnosticRule.strategyBTrigger: Evaluate Strategy B only if Strategy A fails to reduce actual integrand evaluations by at least 90%, has median CPU elapsedTimeRatio > 1.0, or fails to integrate every diagnostic pixel within the declared area bound.
predeclaredDiagnosticRule.resolutionComparisonUses: actual numerical integrand evaluations; legacy budgetChargedEvaluationUnits remain separately reported.

strategyB.reason: Strategy A directly removes the measured dominant source-texel-boundary subdivision; Strategy B is reserved unless Strategy A fails the predeclared efficiency gate.

confirmation.timingCaveat: Full confirmation totals are secondary single-run sums. Repeated matched two-pixel timing medians are primary; these are CPU research timings, not FPS.

researchDecision.rationale: Strategy A resolved 50 former M5T budget-limited pixels; 44 meet analytic, accepted-area, RGB, fixed-grid and M5S diagnostic gates, including all ten S5 pixels. This evidence is bounded to these registered-app pixels.
limitations: Six selected pixels remain unresolved due to one or more finite M5S method disagreements.
The fixed 512 midpoint grid and M5S 1024-sample sequences are finite approximations, not validated high-accuracy ground truth.
No photographic or scene-wide reference authority is established; no claim that sampling alone explains all ROI behavior.
